items.html: A more elaborate matter is this: We have learned that from those kings, the suitable phases were sorted for Atik, AA, and AVI of Atzilut. However, there was some breaking in their posterior. Not actual death, which is the shell, but a diminution of light. Thus, those posterior fell below their place in the holiness itself, and do not have actual dross, which are death. However, in the part of ZON of Atzilut, although all the phases of Malchut in each Sefira were sorted from those kings of the name BON, some sparks which were not sorted remained in them and are mixed inside the shells and the dross. Hence, in these, there is actual death. You find that all the shells grip only ZON, not from Ima and above.
